name: Lasitehtaantie Flat
description: A one-room flat in the 1974 block on Lasitehtaantie, where the glassworks used to be. Shared sauna turns on Thursdays.
greeting: Someone is beating a rug in the yard.
A notice on the door: 'Sauna turn: Thursday 18-19'.
The neighbour's dog barks at nothing.

hello: Remember: no shoes on the stairs.
The laundry room is booked till Sunday.
Is that your bicycle in the hallway?
lease: Here are your keys. Rent is due weekly.
pay_rent: Lovely. I'll write you a receipt.
relax: Don't play the TV too loud.
pellinen: Tell him to open a window. Please.
Pellinen's rent is always on time. I have no idea how.
If you see daylight on him, tell me. I'll call the paper.
broke: Come back when you have it.
refuse: That's not how it works here.

actions.label: Sign a lease
actions.description: Rent is charged weekly. Pay it here.

effects.message: You get the keys. A place of your own!

then.message: Sauna turn, then the sofa in your underwear with ice hockey on TV. Pure kalsarikännit.

else.message: Sauna turn, then the sofa in your underwear with a book. A TV would make this perfect.

actions.label: Game night at Pellinen's
actions.description: Pellinen lives in the basement flat and has not been outside since spring. His door is always open, and the second controller is always charged.

requires.message: Pellinen is in a ranked match and can't pause. He says that every time.

do.message: Pellinen hasn't seen daylight since the last patch. You play until four in the morning. He's honestly great company.
Pellinen carries the whole team, then explains every mistake you made. Twice. You still had a great time.
Energy drinks, cold pizza and a raid that lasts six hours. Pellinen says you're "not totally useless". High praise.
Pellinen shows you his speedrun. It is genuinely impressive. He asks you not to tell his mother how long it took to learn.
